VerifiedBookCacheRecord.title: VerifiedBookCacheRecord
VerifiedBookCacheRecord.description: Server-side cached verified book metadata or Vietnamese edition lookup record with TTL expiration. Contains zero personal data or user text.

cacheKey.description: Normalized cache key (e.g., normalizedTitle::authorSurname or bookId)

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when this cache entry expires

RateLimitBucketRecord.title: RateLimitBucketRecord
RateLimitBucketRecord.description: Server-side sliding-window aggregate counter per hashed client key with TTL expiration.

hitTimestampsMs.description: Bounded list of request epoch timestamps within the current window

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when this rate-limit bucket expires

EvaluationRunRecord.title: EvaluationRunRecord
EvaluationRunRecord.description: Server-side Evaluation Lab benchmark run record (Configurations A, B, C, aggregate metrics, and tester rubric ratings). Contains no personal user data.

status.description: Execution status of the evaluation run

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when this evaluation run expires

/cache_entries/{cacheKey}.description: Server-only TTL cache for verified book metadata and Vietnamese edition records.

/rate_limit_buckets/{bucketKey}.description: Server-only sliding-window rate limit buckets with expiresAtMs cleanup.

/eval_runs/{runId}.description: Server-only Evaluation Lab run records and aggregate metrics.
